question: What are the gross particulars from which the seven lower worlds arise?
premises: In Brahma's first creation, five gross particulars called abundant were made from his own body.
A seventh element is made of them.
The seven worlds are composed from these.
inference: The lower seven worlds arise from five gross elemental particulars produced in Brahma's primal creation, together with their composite form.
uncertainties: The identity of the seventh 'made-of-them' element is not named explicitly in this verse.
plain_english: In Brahma's first creation, five gross particulars called the abundant ones were made from his own body. With a seventh formed from them, these became the basis of the seven worlds.
